<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Your AI Assistant — Start Your Journey</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,300;9..40,400;9..40,500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg-dark:#111416;
  --bg-panel:#13161a;
  --bg-input:#1a1e24;
  --border:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  --border-h:rgba(255,255,255,0.13);
  --text:#eef2f6;
  --muted:rgba(238,242,246,0.48);
  --hint:rgba(238,242,246,0.26);
  --accent:#00d4ff;
  --accent2:#7b8fff;
  --accent-glow:rgba(0,212,255,0.15);
}
body{font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;background:var(--bg-dark);color:var(--text);min-height:100vh;display:flex;overflow:hidden}

/* LEFT */
.left{flex:1.15;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:1.8rem 2rem}

.left-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 10%,rgba(0,212,255,.07) 0%,transparent 55%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 90%,rgba(123,143,255,.06) 0%,transparent 50%),#111416;z-index:0}

.glow-center{position:absolute;bottom:5%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:500px;height:500px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,212,255,.09) 0%,rgba(123,143,255,.05) 35%,transparent 68%);z-index:1;pointer-events:none}

.robot-img{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:90%;max-width:540px;z-index:2;object-fit:cover;mask-image:linear-gradient(to top,#000 45%,rgba(0,0,0,.6) 75%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to top,#000 45%,rgba(0,0,0,.6) 75%,transparent 100%);filter:brightness(.92) contrast(1.06) saturate(.95)}

.back-btn{position:relative;z-index:10;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border:.5px solid var(--border-h);border-radius:20px;padding:6px 14px 6px 10px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;width:fit-content;transition:.2s;text-decoration:none}
.back-btn:hover{background:rgba(0,212,255,.08);border-color:rgba(0,212,255,.3);color:var(--text)}
.back-btn svg{width:13px;height:13px;opacity:.7}

.hero{position:absolute;top:44%;left:2rem;right:2rem;transform:translateY(-70%);z-index:5}
.hero h1{font-family:"Syne",sans-serif;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,4.8vw,4rem);font-weight:800;line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:var(--text)}
.hero h1 .ac{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00d4ff,#7b8fff);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}

.badges{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1.1rem}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(0,212,255,0.06);border:.5px solid rgba(0,212,255,.18);border-radius:20px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent)}

.tcards{position:absolute;bottom:1.8rem;left:2rem;right:2rem;z-index:10;display:flex;gap:9px}
.tc{flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);border:.5px solid var(--border-h);border-radius:13px;padding:11px 13px;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);min-width:0;transition:.2s}
.tc:hover{border-color:rgba(0,212,255,.25);background:rgba(0,212,255,.04)}
.tc-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:5px}
.av{width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0}
.a1{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00d4ff,#7b8fff);color:#0a1020}
.a2{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7b8fff,#c084ff);color:#0a1020}
.a3{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00ffd5,#00d4ff);color:#0a1020}
.tc-name{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text)}
.tc-role{font-size:10px;color:var(--hint)}
.stars{display:flex;gap:2px;margin-bottom:3px}
.star{width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--accent);clip-path:polygon(50% 0%,61% 35%,98% 35%,68% 57%,79% 91%,50% 70%,21% 91%,32% 57%,2% 35%,39% 35%)}
.tc-txt{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}

/* RIGHT */
.right{flex:.88;background:var(--bg-panel);border-left:.5px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:2.8rem 2.4rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.right::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-100px;right:-60px;width:260px;height:260px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,212,255,.06) 0%,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.right::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-80px;left:-40px;width:200px;height:200px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(123,143,255,.05) 0%,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}

.fh{margin-bottom:1.6rem}
.fh h2{font-family:"Syne",sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.2vw,2.7rem);font-weight:700;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--text)}

.tabs{display:flex;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:3px;margin-bottom:1.5rem;width:fit-content}
.tab{padding:7px 22px;border-radius:7px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;color:var(--hint);transition:.2s;border:none;background:transparent;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif}
.tab.active{background:rgba(0,212,255,.1);color:var(--text);border:.5px solid rgba(0,212,255,.25)}

.panel{display:none}
.panel.active{display:block;animation:fu .35s ease both}
@keyframes fu{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes fi{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}

.row{display:flex;gap:9px;margin-bottom:10px}
.fg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
label{font-size:10px;color:var(--hint);margin-bottom:4px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500}
input[type=text],input[type=email],input[type=password]{background:var(--bg-input);border:.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;padding:9px 13px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text);font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;outline:none;transition:.2s;width:100%}
input::placeholder{color:var(--hint)}
input:focus{border-color:rgba(0,212,255,.45);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,212,255,.07)}

.cbrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin:12px 0 18px}
.cbrow input[type=checkbox]{width:13px;height:13px;accent-color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.cbrow span{font-size:11px;color:var(--hint);line-height:1.4}
.cbrow a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}

.sl{font-size:10px;color:var(--hint);text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;position:relative}
.sl::before,.sl::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;width:33%;height:.5px;background:var(--border-h)}
.sl::before{left:0}.sl::after{right:0}

.srow{display:flex;gap:9px;margin-bottom:1.3rem}
.sb{flex:1;background:var(--bg-input);border:.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;padding:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;color:var(--muted)}
.sb:hover{border-color:rgba(0,212,255,.28);background:rgba(0,212,255,.06)}
.sb svg{width:17px;height:17px}

.subrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.already{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--hint)}
.already a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px;cursor:pointer}
.sbtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00d4ff,#7b8fff);border:none;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 20px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#080e1a;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Syne",sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;transition:.2s;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap}
.sbtn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,212,255,.3),0 4px 12px rgba(123,143,255,.2)}
.sbtn svg{width:13px;height:13px}

.fgt{text-align:right;margin:5px 0 18px}
.fgt a{font-size:11px;color:var(--hint);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}

.left{animation:fi .6s ease both}
.hero{animation:fu .7s .1s ease both}
.tcards{animation:fu .7s .28s ease both}
.right{animation:fi .7s .12s ease both}
.fh{animation:fu .6s .22s ease both}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="left">
  <div class="left-bg"></div>
  <div class="glow-center"></div>

  <a class="back-btn" href="#">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M19 12H5M12 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg>
    Back to the webpage
  </a>

  <div class="hero">
    <h1>Your <span class="ac">AI</span><br>Assistant</h1>
    <div class="badges">
      <div class="badge"><span class="dot"></span>+15 Hours Saved</div>
      <div class="badge"><span class="dot"></span>+2000 Users</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <img class="robot-img" id="robotImg" alt="AI Robot" />

  <div class="tcards">
    <div class="tc">
      <div class="tc-h"><div class="av a1">DS</div><div><div class="tc-name">David S.</div><div class="tc-role">Product Designer</div></div></div>
      <div class="stars"><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div></div>
      <div class="tc-txt">Saves me hours every day. Absolutely essential tool.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="tc">
      <div class="tc-h"><div class="av a2">AK</div><div><div class="tc-name">Alisa K.</div><div class="tc-role">Marketing Lead</div></div></div>
      <div class="stars"><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div></div>
      <div class="tc-txt">The smartest AI I have used. Total game changer.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="tc">
      <div class="tc-h"><div class="av a3">JR</div><div><div class="tc-name">James R.</div><div class="tc-role">Founder</div></div></div>
      <div class="stars"><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div><div class="star"></div></div>
      <div class="tc-txt">Onboarded my team in minutes. Productivity up 3x.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="right">
  <div class="fh"><h2>Start Your<br>Journey.</h2></div>

  <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab active" onclick="sw('signup',this)">Sign Up</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="sw('signin',this)">Sign In</button>
  </div>

  <div class="panel active" id="signup">
    <div class="row">
      <div class="fg"><label>First Name</label><input type="text" placeholder="Omar"/></div>
      <div class="fg"><label>Last Name</label><input type="text" placeholder="Al-Rashid"/></div>
    </div>
    <div class="fg" style="margin-bottom:10px"><label>Email</label><input type="email" placeholder="omar@example.com"/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>Password</label><input type="password" placeholder="&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;"/></div>
    <div class="cbrow"><input type="checkbox"/><span>Accept <a href="#">terms and conditions</a> to continue</span></div>
    <div class="sl">Sign up with</div>
    <div class="srow">
      <div class="sb"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z" fill="#4285F4"/><path d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z" fill="#34A853"/><path d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.07H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.93l3.66-2.84z" fill="#FBBC05"/><path d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z" fill="#EA4335"/></svg></div>
      <div class="sb"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M18.71 19.5c-.83 1.24-1.71 2.45-3.05 2.47-1.34.03-1.77-.79-3.29-.79-1.53 0-2 .77-3.27.82-1.31.05-2.3-1.32-3.14-2.53C4.25 17 2.94 12.45 4.7 9.39c.87-1.52 2.43-2.48 4.12-2.51 1.28-.02 2.5.87 3.29.87.78 0 2.26-1.07 3.8-.91.65.03 2.47.26 3.64 1.98-.09.06-2.17 1.28-2.15 3.81.03 3.02 2.65 4.03 2.68 4.04-.03.07-.42 1.44-1.38 2.83M13 3.5c.73-.83 1.94-1.46 2.94-1.5.13 1.17-.34 2.35-1.04 3.19-.69.85-1.83 1.51-2.95 1.42-.15-1.15.41-2.35 1.05-3.11z"/></svg></div>
      <div class="sb"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#1877F2"><path d="M24 12.073c0-6.627-5.373-12-12-12s-12 5.373-12 12c0 5.99 4.388 10.954 10.125 11.854v-8.385H7.078v-3.47h3.047V9.43c0-3.007 1.792-4.669 4.533-4.669 1.312 0 2.686.235 2.686.235v2.953H15.83c-1.491 0-1.956.925-1.956 1.874v2.25h3.328l-.532 3.47h-2.796v8.385C19.612 23.027 24 18.062 24 12.073z"/></svg></div>
    </div>
    <div class="subrow">
      <span class="already">Have an account? <a onclick="swn('signin')">Login</a></span>
      <button class="sbtn">Sign Up <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="panel" id="signin">
    <div class="fg" style="margin-bottom:10px"><label>Email</label><input type="email" placeholder="omar@example.com"/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>Password</label><input type="password" placeholder="&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;&bull;"/></div>
    <div class="fgt"><a href="#">Forgot password?</a></div>
    <div class="sl">Sign in with</div>
    <div class="srow">
      <div class="sb"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z" fill="#4285F4"/><path d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z" fill="#34A853"/><path d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.07H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.93l3.66-2.84z" fill="#FBBC05"/><path d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z" fill="#EA4335"/></svg></div>
      <div class="sb"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M18.71 19.5c-.83 1.24-1.71 2.45-3.05 2.47-1.34.03-1.77-.79-3.29-.79-1.53 0-2 .77-3.27.82-1.31.05-2.3-1.32-3.14-2.53C4.25 17 2.94 12.45 4.7 9.39c.87-1.52 2.43-2.48 4.12-2.51 1.28-.02 2.5.87 3.29.87.78 0 2.26-1.07 3.8-.91.65.03 2.47.26 3.64 1.98-.09.06-2.17 1.28-2.15 3.81.03 3.02 2.65 4.03 2.68 4.04-.03.07-.42 1.44-1.38 2.83M13 3.5c.73-.83 1.94-1.46 2.94-1.5.13 1.17-.34 2.35-1.04 3.19-.69.85-1.83 1.51-2.95 1.42-.15-1.15.41-2.35 1.05-3.11z"/></svg></div>
      <div class="sb"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#1877F2"><path d="M24 12.073c0-6.627-5.373-12-12-12s-12 5.373-12 12c0 5.99 4.388 10.954 10.125 11.854v-8.385H7.078v-3.47h3.047V9.43c0-3.007 1.792-4.669 4.533-4.669 1.312 0 2.686.235 2.686.235v2.953H15.83c-1.491 0-1.956.925-1.956 1.874v2.25h3.328l-.532 3.47h-2.796v8.385C19.612 23.027 24 18.062 24 12.073z"/></svg></div>
    </div>
    <div class="subrow">
      <span class="already">No account? <a onclick="swn('signup')">Sign Up</a></span>
      <button class="sbtn">Sign In <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
function sw(id,btn){document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(t=>t.classList.remove("active"));document.querySelectorAll(".panel").forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("active"));btn.classList.add("active");document.getElementById(id).classList.add("active")}
function swn(id){const tabs=document.querySelectorAll(".tab");const idx=id==="signup"?0:1;document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(t=>t.classList.remove("active"));document.querySelectorAll(".panel").forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("active"));tabs[idx].classList.add("active");document.getElementById(id).classList.add("active")}
document.getElementById("robotImg").src="data:image/png;base64,";
</script>
</body>
</html>
